title: 会议术语与讨论

# 会议术语与讨论

## 概述

本章聚焦会议场景，按会议类型、会议流程、讨论与发言、会议礼仪四个方面组织词汇。内容覆盖从召集会议、推进议程到表达观点、遵守会议规范的完整链条，帮助读者听懂会议内容并主动参与讨论。每个方面都配有听说例句与写作表达，便于口语应对与书面记录。建议把流程类词汇与礼仪类表达对照学习，做到既说清事情，又说得得体。

## 会议类型

| 词汇          | 词性  | 含义       | 常用搭配                                   |
| ------------- | ----- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| standup       | n.    | 站会       | daily standup, standup meeting             |
| retrospective | n.    | 回顾会     | sprint retrospective, hold a retrospective |
| brainstorm    | n./v. | 头脑风暴   | brainstorm ideas, brainstorming session    |
| one-on-one    | n.    | 一对一会议 | weekly one-on-one, schedule a one-on-one   |
| kickoff       | n.    | 启动会     | project kickoff, kickoff meeting           |
| postmortem    | n.    | 复盘       | incident postmortem, conduct a postmortem  |

### 听说例句

> A: Do we have a standup today? B: Yes, at 10 AM. Keep your update under two minutes — just blockers and progress.

> A: Should we do a postmortem on the outage? B: Definitely. Let's schedule it for Friday and invite the on-call engineers.

### 写作表达

- The project kickoff meeting outlined the scope, timeline, and key responsibilities for each team.
- During the retrospective, the team identified three areas for improvement in their release process.

---

## 会议流程

| 词汇        | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                                       |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| agenda      | n.   | 议程     | meeting agenda, set the agenda                 |
| minutes     | n.   | 会议纪要 | take minutes, review minutes                   |
| action item | n.   | 行动项   | assign action items, follow up on action items |
| takeaway    | n.   | 要点     | key takeaway, main takeaway                    |
| consensus   | n.   | 共识     | reach consensus, build consensus               |
| adjourn     | v.   | 散会     | adjourn the meeting, meeting adjourned         |

### 听说例句

> A: What's on the agenda for today's meeting? B: We'll review last week's action items, discuss the Q2 roadmap, and assign new tasks.

> A: Did we reach consensus on the launch date? B: Almost. The key takeaway is that we need one more week of testing before we can commit.

### 写作表达

- The meeting minutes should be distributed to all attendees within 24 hours.
- After extensive discussion, the team reached consensus on adopting a phased rollout strategy.

---

## 讨论与发言

| 词汇      | 词性 | 含义      | 常用搭配                                   |
| --------- | ---- | --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| propose   | v.   | 提议      | propose a solution, propose changes        |
| raise     | v.   | 提出      | raise a concern, raise a question          |
| address   | v.   | 处理/谈及 | address the issue, address concerns        |
| highlight | v.   | 强调      | highlight the risk, highlight key points   |
| elaborate | v.   | 详细说明  | could you elaborate, elaborate on the plan |
| summarize | v.   | 总结      | summarize the discussion, to summarize     |

### 听说例句

> A: I'd like to raise a concern about the timeline. B: Sure, go ahead. Let's address it before we move to the next topic.

> A: Could you elaborate on the technical approach? B: Of course. We propose using a microservice architecture to decouple the payment module.

### 写作表达

- The CTO highlighted the importance of reducing technical debt before scaling the platform.
- To summarize, the team agreed on three priorities: stability, performance, and user experience.

---

## 会议礼仪

| 表达                              | 含义             | 场景     |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------- | -------- |
| Let's get started.                | 我们开始吧       | 开场     |
| Does anyone have anything to add? | 大家还有补充吗？ | 征求意见 |
| Let's table this for now.         | 先搁置一下       | 暂停话题 |
| I'll take this offline.           | 会后再聊         | 转移讨论 |
| Let's wrap up.                    | 我们收尾吧       | 结束     |
| I'll circle back on this.         | 稍后再跟进       | 承诺跟进 |

### 听说例句

> A: We've been going back and forth on this for a while. B: Agreed. Let's table this for now and circle back after we have more data.

> A: There's a design conflict we need to resolve. B: Let's take this offline. I'll set up a separate meeting with the design team.

### 写作表达

- To keep the meeting productive, please review the agenda and come prepared with your updates.
- We will circle back on the unresolved items in next week's follow-up session.
